title: Part (d): the slice homotopy identity in degree 0
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, β ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N+1}) (β : TestFormOn univ 0), x ∈ ℝ^N, and let v : Fin 0 → ℝ^N be the empty tuple. Write ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)), Jv := ι(0, v), e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 and d := exteriorDerivative. Then ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(e₀) dt = β(ι(1, x))() − β(ι(0, x))(). Here the 1-tuple (e₀) is Fin.cons e₀ (J ∘ v), and () is the empty tuple J ∘ v.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) 0) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin 0 → Euclid N), ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, exteriorDerivative (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 1 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))) - (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))
